signal.headline: Managed Money Longs At 88.4th Percentile — Crowded Bullish Stance
signal.description: Hedge funds have accumulated heavy net long exposure (+11,450 contracts this week). Commercial bullion banks have expanded short hedges to -238k contracts. Historical precedence indicates high vulnerability to sharp profit-taking washouts if US Dollar or Real Yields spike.
